Description: Summon your Laudouble minion. A beast assuming the form of a mammet assuming the form of Lauda.
DescriptionEnhanced: Though appearing to be a mammet made in the likeness of the beastmaster Lauda, this entity is squishy to the touch and is in fact some manner of soft-bodied creature with a knack for mimicry. By all indications, it hid itself among a pile of prizes in a ploy to make its way into your company.
Tooltip:
It's double trouble for the challenger!
   - Metem
SpecialActionDescription:
Reduces minion summoning recast time by 50%.
**Duration:** 10s
